source.name: the FunC half of the published scope
source.nature: production, inside a published bug bounty scope
source.note: Read in place, never vendored. Only the review enters this repository.

fixes.what: a slice passed to another function was not recognised as forwarded
fixes.why: `usage` looked for Tolk's `call_argument` node, which the FunC grammar does not have
fixes.shape: elector-code.fc and config-code.fc route by opcode into helpers, end to end

fixes.what: a cooperating sub-parser was asked to end a parse its caller continues
fixes.why: FunC has no `mutate` keyword; it returns the slice instead, and that was not read
fixes.caught_in_review: the first version of the rule also silenced `extractBouncedBody`, which returns a number read out of the slice rather than the slice; a receiver inside a return is not a returned value, and the rule now says so

fixes.what: a slice read inside another call's arguments was taken for a slice handed to it
fixes.why: FunC splices a call and its receiver into the enclosing expression, so the receiver of `body~load_uint(32)` sits in the argument group of `throw_unless` without being given to it — the same distinction already drawn inside a `return`, missing here
fixes.found_by: the six-part review, not by the run

fixes.what: the middle branch of an if/elseif/else chain was never examined
fixes.why: FunC splices `elseif` into the statement rather than nesting it, so one node carries several `consequent` fields and only the first was read

fixes.what: a slice re-pointed at another binding kept its alias, so an end_parse on the new one read as closing the parameter
fixes.why: FunC has no assignment node; the Tolk shape matched nothing and the rule was inert

precision.note: Precision here is against the detector's own contract — the call is absent on some path — and not a claim that any finding is a defect. The first published figure for this round was 32 of 32, measured while a suppression bug was still hiding seven findings; the review found it and the number is restated rather than kept.
